request.prompt: Edit the original White House photograph. Remove every foreground uniformed person and all temporary blue/red/gold inauguration barricades across the bottom, including their supports, event lettering, logos and cast shadows. Also remove small people visible near the house. Reconstruct uninterrupted pavement and road where they stood, with no silhouettes, ghost feet or residual signage. Retain the permanent black iron fence, White House, fountain, lawn, trees, double-globe lamp and flags as architectural scenery. This cleaned image is an intermediate reference, not a final flattened stage. Keep the original separately.

From the original White House reference, extract/repaint a complete opaque 960x640 daytime lightbox. Keep the blue sky, white cloud rhythm and distant Washington Monument silhouette. Remove the White House, nearby trees, fountain, lawn detail, permanent fence, lamp, flags, all people and temporary barricades, including shadows; inpaint their footprints with continuous sky, haze and a restrained low-contrast landscape underlay. The Monument belongs only to this static layer and must not appear in moving geometry. Recompose/outpaint without stretching, cutout holes or landmark ghosts. Apply the approved arcade style and shared palette. No sunset substitution, detailed foreground, text, watermark or alpha.

Replace this photograph with ONLY a daytime sky lightbox for a 1990s arcade fighting game. Blue sky and broad white clouds fill the entire frame from top to bottom. Near the bottom, a single small distant Washington Monument silhouette and a faint hazy skyline. REMOVE THE WHITE HOUSE COMPLETELY. REMOVE ALL TREES, FENCES, PEOPLE, LAMPS, GRASS, FOUNTAIN, PAVEMENT AND ROAD. No building ghosts, no collage, no duplicate monument, no foreground. Crisp saturated pixel art, clean hard-edged color bands, no photograph, no gradients or text. Sky remains visible behind where the house used to be. 3:2 landscape.

image[1] is the White House scene. image[2] is ONLY the arcade art-style reference; DO NOT DRAW THE CHARACTER. Repaint image[1] as bright saturated 90s arcade cel-shaded environment art, crisp shapes, no photorealism. Keep the recognizable White House north facade, columns and portico, trees, vivid green lawn, fountain, permanent black iron fence and double-globe lamp. REMOVE EVERY PERSON and ALL temporary inauguration barricades and event signage. Remove the distant Washington Monument. REMOVE THE SKY AND REPLACE IT WITH ONE COMPLETELY UNIFORM SOLID PURE BLUE SWATCH including the gaps in branches and fence bars. No cloud, gradient or shadow on that blue. Delete the sidewalk and road at the bottom; solid blue there too. No floor slab, text, logos or watermarks. Preserve the architecture's proportions and front-facing landscape composition. Each scene object must have a crisp silhouette ready for segmentation.

request.hint: Separate White House building and columned portico, fountain basin, lawn, hedges, each tree, iron fence modules and double-globe lamp. Exclude transparent background and sky; no road or floor slab. Independently selectable scenery objects for an arcade stage.

generation.notes: Sky and cleaned references are image-model outputs. The house is rendered from segmented Tripo meshes. The revised yard uses independently masked reference-textured 2.5D Blender cards to preserve the generated design, not newly generated or fully reconstructed 3D yard meshes. Trees and the iron fence are deterministic procedural pixel art (scripts/stage_pixel_props.py), not Tripo, Blender or image-model output.

render_settings.shader: 3D house: diffuse -> Shader to RGB -> three constant bands. 2.5D yard: alpha-preserving reference-color emission; shared palette.

blockers: Style, sky cleanliness, composition and in-game human reviews remain pending.
production.reference_edit: Remove people and temporary inauguration barricades; retain the permanent iron fence.

yard_revision.reason: The original Tripo yard distorted the fountain and foliage. Retain the cached meshes, but replace yard exports with separate reference-textured Blender cards; not a new 3D yard generation.

fountain.repair: Paint out fence pixels occluding the lower brown surround.

lamp.repair: Remove the reference tree trunk, vines and stray fringe behind the lamp; fill enclosed pinholes.

street_lamp.method: larger reusable reference streetlight on the sidewalk plane, midground parallax behind the fighters; no collision

lawn.method: locally painted flat lawn backing; no reference collision terrain

foreground_layout.reason: User requested a larger fountain and a wider road and sidewalk to separate the garden scene from the fighters.
foreground_layout.street_lights_reason: User reported the foreground poles drawing in front of the fighters; streetlights now stand on the sidewalk plane (midground) behind them.

house_grounding.reason: User reported the house floating: sky showed through the open portico and foundation gaps above the hedges. Drop the house and flag behind the hedge row and close those gaps with a recessed porch shade.

pixel_art.reason: Playtest feedback: the reference-card trees were clipped by their source boxes and their thin vector branches did not match the chunky cel-shaded stage, and the fence was too small next to the fighters. Paint complete, palette-locked 2 px pixel-art trees and a larger tiling iron fence instead. Bare reference saplings become small leafy trees; overscan duplicates become distinct variants.
pixel_art.tree_depth_reason: User reported trees standing on the fence plane; near trees moved back onto the lawn behind the fence with a slight perspective scale-down.
